# Knowledge Compiler Server

The knowledge compiler server provides a read-only interface to a compiled knowledge base, enabling users to query and retrieve engineering knowledge related to their repository. It includes functionalities to retrieve information about entities, their relationships, and various recommendations for testing and understanding component behaviors.
